claims: Invincible Season 4 premieres on Amazon Prime Video on Wednesday, March 18, 2026.
Invincible Season 4 kicks off with a three-episode release.
Invincible Season 4 has weekly releases for the remainder of the season following the premiere.
The premiere episodes of Invincible Season 4 are episodes 1–3.
Episode 1 of Invincible Season 4 is titled "Making the World a Better Place".
Episode 2 of Invincible Season 4 is titled "I'll Give You the Grand Tour".
Episode 3 of Invincible Season 4 is titled "I Gotta Get Some Air".
The release schedule for Invincible Season 4 is weekly on Wednesdays following the premiere.
The platform for Invincible Season 4 is Amazon Prime Video.
Invincible Season 4 arrives one year after the conclusion of Invincible Season 3.
